# TWRP (TeamWin Recovery Project)

> TWRP is an open-source custom recovery software for Android devices, enabling advanced flashing, backup, and system modification capabilities.

TeamWin Recovery Project (TWRP) provides a touch-based custom recovery environment for Android devices. It serves as an essential tool for developers, enthusiasts, and users who want to flash custom ROMs, create system backups, and modify their Android devices beyond standard manufacturer limitations.
